issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new] Issue #334: Location Grouping System (Geo-Semantic Hybrid) for Add Post
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 05/06/26

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Comit : https://github.com/GoThruMedia/panorra-api-new/commit/a8fb701944551202ac0defe9211bf6386673ae08

Result :

Overview

Implement the Location Grouping system using a Geo-Semantic Hybrid approach to cluster posts into business-level entities (location_group) rather than individual coordinates or raw addresses. Related locations (e.g. "Parking Area" and "Main Store") group under one parent entity, while identical business names in different regions (e.g. "Subang, Indonesia" vs "Subang, Malaysia") keep unique identities.

This function will be called from the Add Post API: when a user creates a post with an address, the system determines whether it belongs to a location_group (global) or location_name (child).

Core Logic Flow

A. Sanitization & Filtering

Sanitize the raw place_name before grouping. Exclude:

  • Google Plus Codes (e.g. 8GG8W4X2+39Q, CQJ7+25R)
  • Raw Addresses — many commas, postal codes, or admin keywords (Jl., Regency, etc.) combined with long string length
  • Flagged Keywords — strings containing "blueline"
  • Too Short — names under 3 characters

Outcome: if invalid, location_group remains NULL.

B. Identity Resolution (Slug Consistency Rule)

  1. Exact Match Search — search entire DB for the exact sanitized name.
  2. Proximity Verification — compute distance to existing group's average coordinates.
  3. Result — if within 15km, reuse the existing location_group_slug (prevents duplicate groups).

C. Semantic Matching & Parent Promotion

  1. Hierarchy Check — "Parking Yogya Grand Subang" joins existing "Yogya Grand Subang" group.
  2. Parent Promotion — a cleaner new name ("Yogya Grand Subang" vs existing "Parking Yogya Grand Subang") is promoted as parent; the location_group_slug stays unchanged to preserve deep-link stability.
  3. Sibling Match — names sharing multiple significant words are treated as the same group.

Database Integration

  • Fields: location_group (display name), location_group_slug (unique identifier / URL slug)
  • Indexing: index on location_group_slug for fast lookups
  • Aggregation: group coordinates via AVG(latitude) and AVG(longitude) for proximity checks

Maintenance & Backfill

  • Worker Integration: runs automatically in PostComplete.go for every new post
  • Cronjob Backfill: /cronjob/backfill-location-grouping endpoint processes historical posts with NULL grouping data, using the same logic as the worker

Success Criteria

  • Posts for the same business in the same city share one slug
  • Same-name businesses in far-apart cities get different slugs
  • Addresses and random codes are never grouped
  • Group names self-correct toward cleaner, parent-level names over time

Source: docs/brainstorming/2026-06-05-location-grouping-final-design.md

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #403: Group places by location group across Place List and Detail APIs
issues.main_description_html:
This is a tracking issue. Work is split into sub-issues (per API + views):

  • #404 — SQL views (DBA prerequisite, blocks the rest)
  • #405 — GET /places/list
  • #406 — GET /places/detail/:slug (header)
  • #407 — GET /places/detail/posts/:slug
  • #408 — GET /places/detail/contributors/:slug
  • #409 — GET /places/detail/bookmarks/:slug

Summary

Re-grain the Place feature from location_name to location_group.

  1. GET /places/list returns one record per unique location_group (instead of per location_name), keeps location_name, and adds location_group + location_group_slug to the response.
  2. The four Place Detail endpoints are looked up by a :location_group_slug route arg instead of the ?location_name query param.

Source columns location_group and location_group_slug already exist on public.posts (docs/migrations/table/DDL_posts.sql:42-43, indexes at lines 49-50).

Full design & step-by-step implementation plan: docs/plans/2026-06-05-place-list-location-group-design.md

Locked decisions

  • DBA/view owner adds the new columns to the SQL views; Go only selects/filters them (per-row grain stays (group, encrypt) so the encrypt NOT IN (...) filter keeps working).
  • List response keeps location_name AND adds location_group + location_group_slug (not a replace).
  • Hide ungrouped places (location_group IS NOT NULL).
  • include param keeps the location_name key and gains location_group / location_group_slug keys.
  • Detail endpoints switch the lookup key to the route arg :location_group_slug; page / limit / include stay query params.
  • Header response adds location_group + location_group_slug.
  • List ?search= matches location_group only.

Scope of work (Go)

  • Models (src/Models/PlacesModel.go) — add location_group + location_group_slug to PlaceListItem, PlaceListItemResponse, PlaceDetailHeader.
  • Routes (src/Routes/V1/PlacesRoutes.go) — new :location_group_slug param routes; register specific /detail/posts|contributors|bookmarks/:slug before the catch-all /detail/:slug.
  • List action (src/Action/V1/Places/GetPlaceList.go) — COUNT(DISTINCT location_group), GROUP BY location_group, location_group_slug, location_name, location_post, thumbnail (global + nearest modes), WHERE location_group IS NOT NULL, search on location_group, response shaping (default + include).
  • Detail actions — swap c.Query("location_name") → c.Params("location_group_slug") and WHERE location_name = ? → WHERE location_group_slug = ? in PlaceDetailHeader.go, PlaceDetailPosts.go, PlaceDetailContributors.go, PlaceDetailBookmarks.go. Header also selects/returns the two new fields.
  • Build & verify — go build ./..., plus manual smoke tests in the plan.

Prerequisite (external / DBA)

The Go code returns empty / 500 until the views expose the new columns. Apply the view changes first (see §3 of the plan), then ship the Go changes.

Out of scope

  • Writing location_group / location_group_slug into posts (owned by the assignment / "plugin executor" service).
  • No places table is introduced.

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #404: Update database views to support place grouping
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 04/06/26

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Views Place List

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_list
AS SELECT p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name, u.encrypt AS encrypt, (SELECT p2.location_post FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p2 WHERE (((p2.location_name = p.location_name) AND (p2.is_publish = true)) AND (p2.visibility = 'public')) AND (p2.banned = false) ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS location_post, (SELECT p2.thumbnail FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p2 WHERE (((p2.location_name = p.location_name) AND (p2.is_publish = true)) AND (p2.visibility = 'public')) AND (p2.banned = false) ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS thumbnail, count(p.id) AS total_posts, COALESCE(sum(v.view_count), 0) AS total_views, json_agg(DISTINCT jsonb_build_object('avatar', u.avatar, 'username', u.username)) FILTER (WHERE u.id IS NOT NULL) AS contributors FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS view_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id WHERE ((((((p.is_publish = true) AND (p.visibility = 'public')) AND (p.banned = false)) AND (p.location_name IS NOT NULL)) AND (p.location_name != '')) AND (u.banned = false)) AND (u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)) GROUP BY p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name, u.encrypt;

Views Place Detail Post

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_detail_posts
AS SELECT p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name, p.slug, p.thumbnail, p.description, p.created_at, p.post_type, p.animation, p.little_planet, p.score_timeline, (p.location_post->>'latitude') AS latitude, (p.location_post->>'longitude') AS longitude, u.encrypt, json_build_object('avatar', u.avatar, 'fullname', u.fullname, 'username', u.username) AS data_user, COALESCE(v.views_count, 0) AS total_views, COALESCE(l.likes_count, 0) AS total_likes, COALESCE(c.comments_count, 0) AS total_comments, CASE WHEN b.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS potd, CAST(NULL AS FLOAT8) AS distance_km FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (post_id) post_id FROM panorra_dev.public.broadcast ORDER BY post_id, created_at DESC) AS b ON b.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS views_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS likes_count FROM panorra_dev.public."like" GROUP BY post_id) AS l ON l.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS comments_count FROM panorra_dev.public.comment WHERE (parent_id IS NULL) AND (banned = false) GROUP BY post_id) AS c ON c.post_id = p.id WHERE ((((((p.is_publish = true) AND (p.visibility = 'public')) AND (p.banned = false)) AND (u.banned = false)) AND (p.location_name IS NOT NULL)) AND (p.location_name != '')) AND (u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)) GROUP BY p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name, p.slug, p.thumbnail, p.description, p.created_at, p.post_type, p.animation, p.little_planet, p.score_timeline, p.location_post, u.encrypt, u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username, b.post_id, v.views_count, l.likes_count, c.comments_count;

Views Place Detail Contributor

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_detail_contributors
AS SELECT location_group, location_group_slug, location_name, user_id, encrypt, avatar, fullname, username, total_posts, total_views, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY location_name ORDER BY total_views DESC, total_posts DESC) AS contributor_rank FROM (SELECT p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name, u.id AS user_id, u.encrypt, u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username, count(p.id) AS total_posts, COALESCE(sum(v.view_count), 0) AS total_views FROM panorra_dev.public.posts AS p JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS view_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id WHERE ((((((p.is_publish = true) AND (p.visibility = 'public')) AND (p.banned = false)) AND (u.banned = false)) AND (p.location_name IS NOT NULL)) AND (p.location_name != '')) AND (u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)) GROUP BY p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name, u.id, u.encrypt, u.avatar, u.fullname, u.username) AS agg;

Views Place Detail Bookmark

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.views_place_detail_bookmarks
AS SELECT p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name, fb.id AS folder_id, fb.name AS folder_name, fb.slug AS folder_slug, u.id AS owner_id, u.avatar AS owner_avatar, u.username AS owner_username, u.encrypt AS owner_encrypt, count(DISTINCT bm.id) AS total_posts, COALESCE(sum(v.view_count), 0) AS total_views, (SELECT p2.thumbnail FROM panorra_dev.public.bookmark AS bm2 JOIN panorra_dev.public.posts AS p2 ON p2.id = bm2.post_id WHERE ((((bm2.folder_id = fb.id) AND (p2.location_name = p.location_name)) AND (p2.is_publish = true)) AND (p2.visibility = 'public')) AND (p2.banned = false) ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS folder_thumbnail, bool_or(CASE WHEN b.post_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END) AS potd FROM panorra_dev.public.folder_bookmark AS fb JOIN panorra_dev.public.users AS u ON u.id = fb.user_id JOIN panorra_dev.public.bookmark AS bm ON bm.folder_id = fb.id JOIN panorra_dev.public.posts AS p ON p.id = bm.post_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, count(*) AS view_count FROM panorra_dev.public.views GROUP BY post_id) AS v ON v.post_id = p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (post_id) post_id FROM panorra_dev.public.broadcast ORDER BY post_id, created_at DESC) AS b ON b.post_id = p.id WHERE (((((((fb.is_published = true) AND (p.is_publish = true)) AND (p.visibility = 'public')) AND (p.banned = false)) AND (u.banned = false)) AND (p.location_name IS NOT NULL)) AND (p.location_name != '')) AND (u.id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM panorra_dev.public.users_request_delete)) GROUP BY fb.id, fb.name, fb.slug, u.id, u.avatar, u.username, u.encrypt, p.location_group, p.location_group_slug, p.location_name;

Part of #403. Full plan: docs/plans/2026-06-05-place-list-location-group-design.md (§3).

Scope — SQL views (DBA / view owner)

⚠️ Prerequisite for all the API tasks. The Go handlers return empty / 500 until these view changes land. Apply this first.

Per-row grain must stay (group, encrypt) so the existing encrypt NOT IN (...) deactivated/blocked-user filter keeps working.

  • views_place_list — add location_group, location_group_slug.
    • Invariant: within one location_group, the columns location_name, thumbnail, location_post must be identical for every row (group representatives) so Go can GROUP BY location_group, location_group_slug, location_name, location_post, thumbnail.
  • views_place_detail_posts — add location_group_slug (new filter key).
  • views_place_detail_contributors — add location_group_slug.
  • views_place_detail_bookmarks — add location_group_slug.

Source columns already exist on public.posts (docs/migrations/table/DDL_posts.sql:42-43, indexes lines 49-50).

Done when

  • The 4 views expose the new columns and the invariant above holds.
  • A spot check SELECT DISTINCT location_group, location_group_slug FROM views_place_list LIMIT 5; returns populated values.

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #405: Update Place List API to group places by location group
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Base Route :

GET /places/list

include :

  • location_group_slug
  • location_group

new_response :

  • location_group_slug
  • location_group

Part of #403. Full plan: docs/plans/2026-06-05-place-list-location-group-design.md (§3.1, Phase 1 + 3).

Blocked by the Views task (views_place_list must expose location_group / location_group_slug).

API: GET /places/list

Re-grain to one record per unique location_group; keep location_name, add location_group + location_group_slug.

Models — src/Models/PlacesModel.go

  • PlaceListItem: add LocationGroup (location_group) + LocationGroupSlug (location_group_slug).
  • PlaceListItemResponse: add the same two fields.

Action — src/Action/V1/Places/GetPlaceList.go

  • Count: COUNT(DISTINCT location_group).
  • Global + nearest fetch: GROUP BY location_group, location_group_slug, location_name, location_post, thumbnail; SELECT prepends the two new columns.
  • Hide ungrouped: WHERE location_group IS NOT NULL (replaces the location_name IS NOT NULL guard).
  • ?search= matches location_group ILIKE ? (both modes).
  • Response shaping: default branch adds location_group + location_group_slug; include branch keeps the location_name key and adds location_group / location_group_slug keys.

Done when

  • One row per unique location_group; response carries location_name, location_group, location_group_slug.
  • Ungrouped rows absent; ?search= filters on location_group; nearest mode still dedupes per group.
  • go build ./... passes.

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go] Issue #406: Update Place Detail API to look up places by group
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT

✅ Implementation Complete — Ready for Unit Testing

Base Route :

GET /places/detail/:location_group_slug

Example change :

GET /places/detail?location_name=Subang -> /places/detail/:location_group_slug

Part of #403. Full plan: docs/plans/2026-06-05-place-list-location-group-design.md (Phase 2, 4.1).

Blocked by the Views task (views_place_list must expose location_group / location_group_slug).

API: GET /places/detail/:location_group_slug (header)

Switch lookup from ?location_name query param to the :location_group_slug route arg.

Route — src/Routes/V1/PlacesRoutes.go

  • Places.Get("/detail/:location_group_slug", Controllers.GetPlaceDetail).
  • Ordering: register the specific /detail/posts|contributors|bookmarks/:slug routes before this catch-all /detail/:slug (coordinate with the other detail tasks — shared file).

Model — src/Models/PlacesModel.go

  • PlaceDetailHeader: add LocationGroup + LocationGroupSlug.

Action — src/Action/V1/Places/PlaceDetailHeader.go

  • Read c.Params("location_group_slug"); drop the c.Query("location_name") + " " → "+" normalization. Empty → 400 "location_group_slug is required".
  • Header query: Select(... location_group, location_group_slug, location_name, thumbnail, location_post, SUM(...) ...), Where("location_group_slug = ?", slug), Group("location_group, location_group_slug, location_name, thumbnail, location_post").
  • Keep header.LocationName = strings.ReplaceAll(... "+", " ").
  • include branch: add location_group / location_group_slug keys.

Done when

  • Endpoint resolves by slug; response includes location_group + location_group_slug (plus representative location_name). go build ./... passes.
